```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import importlib.util, sys
from pathlib import Path

# Locate _render.py regardless of where Quarto invokes us from.
_here = Path(sys.path[0] or ".").resolve()
for candidate in (_here, _here / "cv", Path.cwd() / "cv", Path.cwd()):
    if (candidate / "_render.py").exists():
        _render_dir = candidate
        break
else:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not locate cv/_render.py")

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_render", _render_dir / "_render.py")
_render = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(_render)

yaml_path = (_render_dir.parent / "_data" / "cv.yml").resolve()
print(_render.render_cv(str(yaml_path)))
```
